subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: What public Telegram message-tool action shape should OpenClaw support for destructive forum-topic lifecycle operations?
rationale: The remaining work adds public message action/config surface and destructive Telegram admin behavior, so automation should not choose naming or deletion semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add explicit lifecycle actions
options.body: Add distinct `topic-close`, `topic-reopen`, and `topic-delete` actions mapped to Telegram Bot API lifecycle calls, keeping generic message deletion separate.

options.title: Overload generic delete
options.body: Route `delete` to message deletion or forum-topic deletion by supplied IDs, accepting a larger compatibility and user-confusion risk.

options.title: Defer destructive operations
options.body: Leave only create/edit until maintainers explicitly approve delete semantics and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Add explicit lifecycle actions
recommendation.body: Add distinct `topic-close`, `topic-reopen`, and `topic-delete` actions mapped to Telegram Bot API lifecycle calls, keeping generic message deletion separate.
